text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-chan...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what happened, Kitasan...? Were you 
not feeling well...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't hold on at the end like I 
usually do. Kitasan would've done much 
better..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Hanging your head isn't like you at all! 
Where's that usual fire, Kitasan?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan!!

Kitasan Black's running lacked its usual 
sharpness. The reason she couldn't 
demonstrate her true power was likely—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah......... Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-I just couldn't bear... listening to 
what the spectators were saying...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm the one who ran a pathetic 
race, but still...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh... But...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I totally let them dooooown!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHN!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Kita-chan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Kita-chan, were you perhaps not feeling 
your best today...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... *sniff*... Something feels... 
weird today... My body feels so heavy...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even though I know I have to pick up the 
pace... ngh, my legs... just won't 
move...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...And I worked so hard, too...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Takarazuka Kinen'... *sniff*... 
To come in first in the fan poll... I'm so 
happy...!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I was trying so hard to live up to 
everyone's expectations... I worked so, so 
hard, and yet...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat the heck?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Maybe... they were still feeling the 
fatigue from the Tenno Sho (Spring). That 
happened to me too.

Fatigue still lingered within Kitasan 
Black from that fierce battle at the Tenno 
Sho (Spring). She simply hadn't noticed it 
herself.

Driven by the desire to live up to 
everyone's expectations, she pushed 
through the fatigue. However, the fatigue 
didn't vanish; instead, it only seemed to 
accumulate.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
She just pushed herself too hard... That's 
so like Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Was I... tired...? No way... but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
To think I overlooked the state of my own 
body... And ended up letting everyone down 
because of it...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so frustrated... It really, really 
stings...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
“—It's okay. I'm sure the fans know that 
Kita-chan just pushed herself too hard.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because everyone has watched Kita-chan 
giving it her all, and drawn inspiration 
from her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Still, after everyone went out of their 
way to vote for me, messing up like 
this... I'm sure everyone's going to be so 
exasperated with me...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Because I let everyone down, will 
people stop cheering for me...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... After all, the only reason someone 
plain like me ever started getting any 
attention was because I was winning...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's because you kept winning that more 
and more people started cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"If I don't win, I'll just be an ordinary, 
unremarkable Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a sharp finishing burst like 
Dia-chan, or any weapon like that. I'm 
just an ordinary girl who can only try her 
best...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes Kita-chan so amazing, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How hard and earnestly you give it your 
all. Seeing that dedication is probably 
why everyone wants to cheer you on.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I think they truly love Kita-chan for all 
the hard work she put in, running 
tirelessly to reach this point.

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black runs with everything she's 
got, so you just can't help but root for 
her. She's so earnest, you know?

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally! She's not flashy or 
anything, just kinda normal. Feels like 
she's one of us.

text_block_list.name: Departing Male Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That's why you end up rooting for them to 
win! It feels like your own efforts are 
being rewarded, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They said whenever Kita-chan wins, they 
feel as happy as if it were their own 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
“Seeing Kitasan work hard gives me the 
strength to work hard too.” ...Unlike me, 
Kita-chan has people cheering for her like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, I feel a little jealous, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Which means it's the Spring Senior Triple 
Crown! Let's go take it, Kitasan!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Kitasaaaan! Let's get our revenge for last 
year!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Having someone root for you as if it were 
their own matter isn't something that 
happens every day, you know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"The fans don't just love your strength, 
they love you for who you are, Kita-chan."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So, I'm totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You might be disappointed today. But your 
fans still have high hopes for you, 
Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Expectations...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Because I believe in you, Kita-chan.

After leaving the waiting room, Satono 
Diamond seemed to be lost in deep thought 
about something.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, what side of me do you want to 
see?

Unsure of the question's intent, I asked 
for clarification.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking. If Kita-chan is the 
kind of person people cheer for because 
they see themselves in her, then what is 
it that people are looking for from me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Contributing as a "great Umamusume"... 
Kita-chan is already contributing by 
bringing smiles to everyone's faces.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Yet I still cannot even see what I am 
capable of achieving..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What I must do for the advancement of the 
Umamusume world...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"As an Umamusume, what could my running 
possibly bring to everyone...?"

What is expected of Satono Diamond. The 
dream that her running shows to the fans.

The running of a "great Umamusume" shows 
each of us a one-of-a-kind dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Possibility...

Possessing such unwavering resolve, she 
has the power to make one feel she could 
overturn the impossible itself.

Having overcome the jinx that had bound 
the Satono family for so many years, it 
felt as though she might just be able to 
achieve it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I see... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I'll try to reflect on it more deeply 
in my own way...

Satono Diamond falls deep into thought 
again. Not wanting to disturb her, I 
walked in silence all the way to the 
station.
